task.title: Make Management AI -> OpenClaw actually work live (fix the post-#1714/#1723 fake-greens end-to-end)
task.summary_zh: 現況查證:ASSISTANT-OPENCLAW-CHANNEL(#1714)/OPENCLAW-AGENT-TURN-LIVE-FIX(#1723) 雖歸檔 done,但實機打 dev 後 Management AI 每次回 degraded 字串『openclaw binary not found』,完全沒在跑——連續多層假綠(測試 mock CLI、pytest live smoke @skipUnless 無 binary 即 skip、6/16『OPENCLAW_LIVE 通過』其實是在 gateway 容器內跑 loopback 非真實 serving path)。四層修復:(1)PR #1735 OPENCLAW-ADAPTER-CLI-BAKE — multi-stage 從受治理 pin ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:2026.6.6 把 openclaw CLI(/app + Node24)烤進 adapter image(openclaw 不在 npm),隔離 /opt/openclaw 不污染 codex/claude 的 Node20,build 時 openclaw --version 自驗。(2)PR #1736 OPENCLAW-ADAPTER-AGENT-TURN-FIX — provider 用了不存在的 --url/--token flag,2026.6.6 agent 從 env OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN 讀;補 OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_PRIVATE_WS=1(docker 私網 plaintext ws break-glass)+ 持久 openclaw-adapter-data volume + 解析真實 --json envelope(result.meta.finalAssistantVisibleText)。(3)device pairing — 2026.6.6 gateway 要求遠端 client 先 openclaw devices approve 一次(持久 volume 保留);runbook docs/runbooks/openclaw-adapter-device-pairing.md。(4)PR #1738 OPENCLAW-ADAPTER-STDIN-PROMPT — Management AI 大 prompt 超 argv MAX_ARG_STRLEN(128KiB)『Argument list too long』,改 --message - 走 stdin。Live 實證:adapter HTTP invoke -> OPENCLAW_LIVE(transport=cli);/bff/management/nl/ask -> gpt-5.5 真實回覆。gateway 側 model auth 本來就 OK。禁止造假已遵守:每層只在打真 deployed adapter 時現形、逐一實機驗。
acceptance: adapter image contains a working openclaw CLI (openclaw --version -> OpenClaw 2026.6.6) [done #1735]
adapter HTTP openclaw provider invoke returns OPENCLAW_LIVE with transport=cli (non-mock) [done]
BFF /bff/management/nl/ask returns a real model answer, not a degraded/argv-error string [done]
non-skip live smoke scripts/openclaw-assistant-openclaw-live-smoke.sh exists for future deploys [done]
device pairing persisted on openclaw-adapter-data volume + one-time approval runbook [done]
task.next: Closed: all three PRs merged to dev and deployed to dev VM; live-verified Management AI -> OpenClaw end-to-end (adapter invoke OPENCLAW_LIVE; /bff/management/nl/ask returns real gpt-5.5 answer). Watch for overlap with task/OPENCLAW-MGMT-TURN-RPC: if that lands a different transport, align it with this CLI-over-WS path rather than diverging.
